ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$0.92 (Ryde voucher) for the unexempted 0.65 km detour via Sims Avenue/generic turn-off; note the RD-1 breach.
ruling.reasoning:
Service type RydeTAXI → metered, so extra distance directly enters the fare (RD-2). Quoted route 15.472 km / 21.8 min vs metered 19.4 km / 31.75 min; per-km rate = distance_fare ÷ distance_km = 27.35 ÷ 19.4 = 1.4098 S$/km.

Trace vs quoted route: from pickup (12:14:20) the car follows the quoted corridor along the CTE up to ~12:25:50 (1.32431,103.872327). The only off-route place is the 12:26:20–12:30:20 stretch: the car turns off at Jalan Eunos (1.32245,103.873718), stops (speed 0) at 12:26:50 on Sims Avenue East (1.32171,103.87427), then doubles back west via 1.318841,103.875336 and 1.31776,103.875035 and rejoins the corridor at ~12:30:50 (1.314746,103.874873). Off-corridor length ≈ 0.90 km, on-corridor overlap ≈ 1.30 km → net excess ≈ 0.65 km.

The chat shows the rider consented before the turn-off (12:27:30 rider "Sure, go ahead." vs turn-off at ~12:26:20–12:26:50 and stop at 12:26:50; the driver's 12:26:50 message precedes). But the consent is to a named road, Sims Avenue: under RD-5, a named-road consent covers driving on that road only and the record must tie the driven segment to that road; the SIMS AVE EAST stop over the 200 m corridor (m_from_route > 200 for 12:26:50–12:28:20) is exempt, while the post-stop westward backtrack to rejoin is not tied to Sims Avenue and is even partly under the PIE (band 2 = moderate, not the band 1–2 severe-congestion requirement) → counts (RD-4(b) cannot exempt alone).

Amount: 0.65 km × 1.4098 = S$0.92 (rounded). The metered waiting component ($0.11 = 26¢ per 45 s unit, wait standing during the Sims stop) is retained per RD-3(c) (RydeTAXI waiting is chargeable), so no separate waiver. The rider's expectation of fixed-quote pricing does not apply to RydeTAXI (policy §0).

segment_findings.reason: Take off at Jalan Eunos (12:26:20, 1.32245,103.873718) and the westward backtrack along Sims Avenue East after the stop (12:28:20–12:30:20, 1.320077,103.876669 → 1.31776,103.875035) are off the quoted corridor. The rider's 12:27:30 consent to 'via Sims Avenue' is a named-road consent: the stop over Sims Ave East is covered, but the backtrack to rejoin is not tied to Sims Avenue (RD-5, G13). PIE band 2 at 12:20:50 is at a different time/base point and is only corroborative, cannot alone exempt (RD-4(b), G3). Net excess ≈ 0.65 km.

The rider's own message 'Sure, go ahead.' at 12:27:30, sent before the car's own movement into the stop, consents to the driver's proposed route via Sims Avenue (RD-5). The stop at 1.32171,103.87427 (12:26:50) lies on Sims Avenue East (m_from_route > 200 m, the only 'off-route' sample) and is covered by the named-road consent (RD-3(a)/RD-5), and its standing time is chargeable on RydeTAXI (RD-3(c)); the exit from the stop back to Sims Avenue East is on Sims Avenue (RD-5).

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's claim of a verbal pre-trip agreement adds nothing beyond the chat; the chat itself (12:26:50 driver / 12:27:30 rider) is the recorded consent, and it covers the named road only, not the whole detour (RD-5, G11).

The rider's claim that the fare should equal the app estimate is rejected: RydeTAXI is metered, not quoted (policy §0, RD-2), so the difference between the 15.472 km quoted route and the 19.4 km driven route is not in itself refundable; only the unexempted off-route excess is.
